notes.title: Sanitarium update
notes.content:
Hello all,

A updated version of the game is now available. It fixes all crash & save issues.
If you had any problem before, please restart Steam to enjoy the new version.

Let us know if there is any other issue.
Have fun with the game! 

The DotEmu Team
